snippet.title: Arcade Game Zone - PlayStation 5 Gameplay
snippet.description:
Welcome to the most exhilarating arcade experience in the gaming world - Arcade Game Zone!

Arcade Game Zone brings together 40 mini-games, including 30 faithful replicas of classics found in legendary arcade cabinets. But that's not all; we've also included 10 iconic games such as darts, foosball, billiards, bowling, and many more that you commonly find in renowned arcade establishments worldwide.

Challenge all your friends and play classic games that have left an indelible mark on generations. Whether it's an intense foosball showdown or a spirited game of darts, Arcade Game Zone offers an unrivalled multiplayer experience. Laughter and competition await, just like in a real arcade.

Published by Just For Games
Developed by BreakFirst Games
Also released for Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch
